name: British East India Company (to 1707)
description: Thirteen alternating red and white horizontal stripes with a white canton bearing the red cross of St George.
history: The striped ensign of the English East India Company, flown from the early seventeenth century with the cross of St George in the canton; the number of stripes varied. After the Acts of Union of 1707 the canton was changed to the Union Flag of Great Britain.
